name: Kawasaki W650 / W800
engine: 676 cc (W650, carbs) or 773 cc (W800, fuel injected) air-cooled SOHC parallel twin, bevel-drive cam
intro: Kawasaki's retro twin with a bevel-driven cam. Very reliable. The bevel drive must be set up right after any work.

add.title: Check the bevel drive
add.instructions: Listen for unusual noise from the bevel drive tower and look for oil weeping at the top and bottom of the shaft.
add.reason: The bevel drive is easy to set up wrong during service, and that causes wear.
add.src: Return of the Cafe Racers W650 notes

G: W650s have carbs and W800s are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match your bike.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Bevel drive setup
known.what: Owners say the bevel drive adjustment is different from Ducati's and often gets done wrong during service.
